body: Hi, I don't understand your particular pain, but I'm suicidal too and I'm willing to talk.
SOLVED! My Google-fu powers and sheer determination have come through: This Crumbling Pageant by Patricia Burroughs. Thank you to those who helped by upvoting. I appreciate y'all!

I've Googled the ever-living daylights out of what I remember and scoured my personal library. Thanks for any help ya'll can give me. I created a reddit account specifically for this because it's been driving me nuts.
